about: Add a Delete button for files (and folders) that also runs the agent to clean the system of the item, with an optional note for the AI to keep in mind; drop the page's statuses (exists, pattern and the rest) and keep only "changed", set after every request from the page, with more statuses maybe later.
changes_when: Never in the owner's words; only its answer and what it was processed into are added once its knowledge is placed.

update_with.how: Keep its row (summary, categories, processed_into, answered) the same as this file.
